# Portenv

> Portenv — your portable workspace (short for portable environment; also heard as 'port env'). Resume your work anywhere: an encrypted workspace that moves between your Mac and your own servers, and that your agents can join, on your terms.

Each project gets a workspace ("box") that moves between your Mac and your own servers, and that agents with their own computers can work in, on your terms.

Status: Available for Mac (macOS 26 or later, Apple silicon). Download: https://portenv.com/download

## What it is

- A native Mac app (macOS 26 or later, Apple silicon), free. It uses Docker Desktop for now.
- Each box is encrypted on your device before it is saved, and saves as you go.
- Open-source core: the runner, the in-box agent and the save format are Apache-2.0.
- Works with your own servers and storage, without a Portenv account.

## Agents

Works with agents that run in a terminal, such as Claude Code, and with agents on their own computers over SSH (Preview, off until you turn it on). You invite an agent to one box, see what it does, and can revoke it at any time. Agents never get your encryption keys.
